## Synopsis

```text
Meziantou.Framework.Geo.Maps.Tool pack [options]
```

## Description

Builds the bundles of regions, and a NuGet package per bundle: by default, an assembly built by the .NET SDK that embeds the map and opens it with Map.Region\_\<Key\>

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--region <region>` | The regions to build, separated by commas. A region is world, a continent (africa, antarctica, asia, europe, north-america, oceania, south-america), or a country or territory: its English name in lowercase words joined by hyphens (switzerland, united-states, cote-divoire), its key (Switzerland, UnitedStates) or its ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (CH, US). The list command lists them. |  |
| `--all` | Builds every region: the world, the continents, and every country and territory |  |
| `--output <output>` | The folder of the bundles | `maps` |
| `--format <format>` | The format of the bundles: fgb (a folder of FlatGeobuf files per region), geojson (a folder of GeoJSON files per region) or gpkg (a GeoPackage file per region) | `fgb` |
| `--layers <layers>` | The layers to write, separated by commas: borders, states-provinces, cities, rivers, lakes, coastline, land, ocean, marine-areas, physical-regions (default: all of them) |  |
| `--previews <previews>` | A folder to render a preview of each bundle to, as SVG and PNG |  |
| `--pins <pins>` | A file of pins to use instead of the pins of the tool, as the update-pins command writes it |  |
| `--cache <cache>` | The folder of the downloaded sources (default: the application data folder of the user) |  |
| `--package-output <package-output>` | The folder of the packages | `packages` |
| `--package-id-prefix <package-id-prefix>` | The prefix of the identifiers of the packages, followed by the key of the region, such as GeoMaps.France | `GeoMaps` |
| `--package-version <package-version>` | The version of the packages | `1.0.0` |
| `--authors <authors>` | The authors of the packages (default: the prefix of their identifiers) |  |
| `--package-content <package-content>` | How the packages ship the maps: assembly (an assembly that embeds the map, built with the .NET SDK, opened with Map.Region\_\<Key\>) or files (files copied to the maps folder next to the application, read by MapCatalog.Default; required for gpkg) | `assembly` |
| `--package-sdk <package-sdk>` | The MSBuild SDK of the projects of the assemblies, such as Meziantou.NET.Sdk; the folders above the projects give its version, in a global.json file | `Microsoft.NET.Sdk` |
| `--package-target-framework <package-target-framework>` | The target frameworks of the assemblies, separated by semicolons (net10.0 or later), or an MSBuild property that gives them, such as $(LatestTargetFrameworks), defined in a Directory.Build.props file above --package-project-output | `net10.0` |
| `--package-project-output <package-project-output>` | A folder to write the projects of the assemblies to and keep them: the projects import the MSBuild files of the folders above them, such as Directory.Build.props (default: a temporary folder, where they import none) |  |
| `-?`, `-h`, `--help` | Show help and usage information |  |
